description: The plot illustrates the relationship between answer popularity and three different values: accuracy, confidence, and alignment. The x-axis is labeled “Answer Popularity” and is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 300, with tick labels at intervals of 50. The y-axis is labeled “Values” and is a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. A blue line, marked with diamond shapes, represents “Accuracy” and begins at a value of approximately 0.48 at an answer popularity of 0, decreases to a value of approximately 0.23 at an answer popularity of 50, then increases to a value of approximately 0.83 at an answer popularity of 250, and concludes at a value of approximately 0.76 at an answer popularity of 300. A green line, marked with triangle shapes, represents “Confidence” and begins at a value of approximately 0.85 at an answer popularity of 0, increases to a peak value of approximately 0.89 at an answer popularity of 75, then decreases to a value of approximately 0.81 at an answer popularity of 300. A red line, marked with square shapes, represents “Alignment” and begins at a value of approximately 0.54 at an answer popularity of 0, decreases to a value of approximately 0.41 at an answer popularity of 50, increases to a value of approximately 0.68 at an answer popularity of 100, then decreases to a value of approximately 0.52 at an answer popularity of 300.
